Python SDK ToolInvocation has no cancellation signal field: SDK task cancellation propagates and the host cancelled/deadline guard runs before ToolResult. No SDK token or new production Abort API is invented.
The original basic replay recording still cannot prove user history or streaming; the new SDK protocol peer is deterministic test evidence only.

The 90-second clock bounds joining and completion once a harness is owned. Facade bootstrap has no cancellation parameter; interruption of an open that never settles is not guaranteed or proved by these tests.
